# Package tests

The canonical test file exercises public validation, fitted-object contracts,
prediction targets, deterministic parallel behavior, frozen-data integrity,
and installed experiment resource discovery.

```{r install-package-tests, include=FALSE}
repository_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
test_source <- file.path(repository_dir, "script", "package-tests", "tests.R")
test_dir <- file.path(usethis::proj_get(), "tests", "testthat")
dir.create(test_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
test_target <- file.path(test_dir, "test-package.R")
stopifnot(file.copy(test_source, test_target, overwrite = TRUE))
stopifnot(identical(
  unname(tools::md5sum(test_source)), unname(tools::md5sum(test_target))
))
writeLines(
  c(
    "library(testthat)",
    "library(eivGP)",
    "",
    "test_check('eivGP')"
  ),
  file.path(usethis::proj_get(), "tests", "testthat.R")
)
```
